info.name: DhammaNature REST API
info.description:
Merged collection for every REST controller (auth, centers, events, gallery, products, marketplace, blog, donations, quizzes, rewards, volunteer, newsletter, profile, images, admin).

Runs against the Spring Boot app on http://localhost:3069. Authentication is cookie/session based: run a Login request first and Postman reuses the JSESSIONID cookie from its cookie jar.

Request order matters:
1. Auth > Login (member) establishes the session.
2. Public and member folders run with that session.
3. Admin > Login (admin) switches the session to an administrator before the admin writes.

Set `email`/`password` (member) and `adminEmail`/`adminPassword` (administrator) variables. Resource IDs are captured automatically from list/create responses.
